metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘I can’t even explain this’ and enemy just disappeared LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I accidentally hit the target? 
My aim was on a coffee break but the enemy wasn’t.
Click if your best plays are total chaos with zero effort!

Tap if your aim takes naps but the kills still happen!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
